Third-party assets used by the SyllaSync dashboard

Tabler UI 1.4.0 — MIT license
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.4.0/dist/css/tabler.min.css
Project: https://github.com/tabler/tabler
License: TABLER-LICENSE.txt
The compiled CSS is vendored as tabler-scoped.min.css. Selectors are prefixed
with .ss (root selectors remapped to .ss) to isolate the UI kit from Streamlit.
The original CSS copyright notice is retained. SyllaSync's own overrides live
in ../dashboard.css. Bootstrap is included in Tabler's compiled stylesheet; its MIT copyright
and permission notice are preserved in BOOTSTRAP-LICENSE.txt.

Tabler Icons 3.35.0 — MIT license
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons@3.35.0/icons/outline/
Project: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
License: TABLER-ICONS-LICENSE.txt
A subset of outline SVG icons is vendored in tabler-icons/. Runtime changes
add accessibility attributes and set decorative sidebar icon colors.

No paid template, charting library, or externally hosted runtime asset is used.
